classClosure.reason: No self-triggered loop: each new action fires at most once per cause, held by state that only moves one way. The per-tick machine-key self-add adds once per machine, then reports present. The Basic fork merge runs only on the lease holder with no split-brain, only while forked, and never after the first owner key. The kept-devices notice fires once per migration, which runs once per machine and is saved on disk. The dropped-devices notice fires only when the kept list shrinks, which it can do at most as many times as it has entries. The removal DM is user-driven (one per removal request, at most 20 pending).
